Declared 2026-09-24. bulk/snrna_lobe = frontal is an INFERENCE, not read from this cohort's own metadata: the biospecimen CSV records only hemisphere ("left cerebral hemisphere"), no Brodmann area, for 495 of 508 donors (the other 13, "BEB-Miller", ARE explicitly recorded as dorsolateral prefrontal cortex). Living Brain Project biopsies are collected via a frontal burr hole during DBS lead placement, which is why frontal is used here for the rest too, but this has not been confirmed against the flagship publication -- see /project/rrg-shreejoy/LBP/NOTES.md. snrna_region = "living" (not hemisphere-specific): the LBP_liv snRNA object does not record which hemisphere each donor's biopsy came from. n_matched left blank until LBP_liv counts exist; up to 148 living-left bulk donors are available to match.
